reason: A mail recipient is an e-mail address, a messenger's a chat. The owner ruled both meanings belong to --to (cli-base 0.71 lists <address> beside <chat>, and the command lint accepts it); the cross-CLI audit does not read that list yet, so it still sees two meanings.

A mail subject line is text, memo's --subject a reference to what a note is about. The owner ruled both meanings belong to --subject (cli-base 0.71 lists <text> beside <ref>, and the command lint accepts it); the cross-CLI audit does not read that list yet, so it still sees two meanings.
